registers.name: sha_cap0
registers.description: Capability register 0. Reports the algorithms, contexts and bus width built into this instance.

fields.name: alg
fields.description:
Built algorithm map. One bit for each hash algorithm; the bit is 1 when that algorithm exists in the hardware.

Usage: Read by software before it writes the algorithm field of the control register; a code whose bit is 0 sets the configuration error event.

Values:
0x002 only SHA-256 built (reset value);
0x001 to 0xFFF bit mask: bit 0 SHA-224, 1 SHA-256, 2 SHA-384, 3 SHA-512, 4 SHA-512/224, 5 SHA-512/256, 6 SHA3-224, 7 SHA3-256, 8 SHA3-384, 9 SHA3-512, 10 SHAKE128, 11 SHAKE256.

Unit: mask

Limits: Constant after elaboration; at least one bit is 1.

fields.name: ctxn
fields.description:
Number of contexts. Number of independent messages that the IP keeps in progress at the same time, set by the elaboration parameter.

Usage: Read by software to know how many interleaved messages it may start and the legal range of the context select field.

Values:
0x01 to 0x10 context count (reset value 0x01).

Unit: contexts

Limits: Constant after elaboration; legal values 1 to 16.

fields.name: axiw
fields.description:
AXI data width code. Width of the AXI4 data bus of the message and digest windows, set by the elaboration parameter.

Usage: Read by software to find how many bytes one window beat carries.

Values:
0x0 32 bits;
0x1 64 bits (reset value);
0x2 128 bits.

Unit: code

Limits: Constant after elaboration.

fields.name: rev
fields.description:
Register map revision. Version number of this register description.

Usage: Read by software to select the driver for this register layout.

Values:
0x1 first revision (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: Incremented by each incompatible change of the map.

registers.name: sha_cap1
registers.description: Capability register 1. Reports the round unrolling and the optional security and DMA features of this instance.

fields.name: s256unr
fields.description:
SHA-256 core unrolling. Number of SHA-256 and SHA-224 rounds that the hardware computes in one clock cycle.

Usage: Read by software to compute the time per block: 64 divided by this value, times the pipeline factor, plus 2 cycles.

Values:
0x01 to 0x40 rounds per cycle (reset value 0x01).

Unit: rounds

Limits: A divisor of 64; zero when no SHA-224 or SHA-256 is built.

fields.name: s512unr
fields.description:
SHA-512 core unrolling. Number of SHA-384, SHA-512 and SHA-512/t rounds that the hardware computes in one clock cycle.

Usage: Read by software to compute the time per block: 80 divided by this value, times the pipeline factor, plus 2 cycles.

Values:
0x00 core not built (reset value);
0x01 to 0x50 rounds per cycle.

Unit: rounds

Limits: A divisor of 80.

fields.name: kecunr
fields.description:
Keccak core unrolling. Number of Keccak-f[1600] rounds that the hardware computes in one clock cycle.

Usage: Read by software to compute the time per block: 24 divided by this value, times the pipeline factor, plus 2 cycles.

Values:
0x00 core not built (reset value);
0x01 to 0x18 rounds per cycle.

Unit: rounds

Limits: A divisor of 24.

fields.name: fdup
fields.description:
Duplicate-core detection built in. Indicates that a second copy of each core runs in parallel and its results are compared.

Usage: Read by software before it sets the duplicate detection field of the security register.

Values:
0x0 not built (reset value);
0x1 built.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: fpar
fields.description:
Parity detection built in. Indicates that parity bits protect the state registers and the context memory.

Usage: Read by software before it sets the parity detection field of the security register.

Values:
0x0 not built (reset value);
0x1 built.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: fredo
fields.description:
Recompute detection built in. Indicates that every block can be computed twice and the results compared.

Usage: Read by software before it sets the recompute detection field of the security register.

Values:
0x0 not built (reset value);
0x1 built.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: mask
fields.description:
Masked Keccak built in. Indicates that the Keccak core runs on two shares with random masking of the first order.

Usage: Read by software before it sets the mask enable field of the control register.

Values:
0x0 not built (reset value);
0x1 built.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: zero
fields.description:
State clearing built in. Indicates that the context memory, the FIFOs and the core registers can be cleared.

Usage: Read by software before it relies on the clear command or on the automatic clearing.

Values:
0x0 not built;
0x1 built (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: dma
fields.description:
External DMA handshake built in. Indicates that the request and acknowledge ports of an external DMA controller are active.

Usage: Read by software before it sets the DMA enable field of the control register.

Values:
0x0 not built (reset value);
0x1 built.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: sdsrc
fields.description:
Mask seed source. Selects where the random generator of the masked Keccak core gets its seed: the entropy input port or the seed registers.

Usage: Read by software to know whether it has to write the seed registers and give the seed command.

Values:
0x0 entropy input port (reset value);
0x1 seed registers written by software.

Unit: none

Limits: Meaningful only when masked Keccak is built.

registers.name: sha_ctrl
registers.description: Control register. Enables the IP and selects the algorithm and the context for the next commands.

fields.name: en
fields.description:
IP enable. Enables the datapath; when 0 the sequencer starts no new block and the windows still accept data.

Usage: Program it after the algorithm is chosen; clearing it while a block runs lets that block finish and holds the next ones.

Values:
0x0 disabled (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: algo
ctxsel
fields.description:
Context select. Selects the context that the commands, the length register and the status, level and counter registers refer to.

Usage: Program it before every command that concerns one context; it does not change the window address, which carries the context number.

Values:
0x00 to 0x0F context number (reset value 0x00).

Unit: none

Limits: Must be below the context count of the capability register; a larger value sets the configuration error event.

fields.name: mask
fields.description:
Mask enable. Runs the Keccak algorithms on two shares with random masking when the masked Keccak core is built.

Usage: Program it while no SHA-3 or SHAKE message is in progress; it applies to the messages started afterwards.

Values:
0x0 unmasked Keccak (reset value);
0x1 masked Keccak.

Unit: none

Limits: Ignored when the capability register reports no masked Keccak.

fields.name: dmaen
fields.description:
External DMA enable. Lets the IP raise the request signals of the external DMA handshake for the input and output windows.

Usage: Program it when a DMA controller moves the message and the digest; clear it when software writes the windows.

Values:
0x0 handshake off (reset value);
0x1 handshake on.

Unit: none

Limits: Ignored when the capability register reports no DMA handshake.

registers.name: sha_cmd
registers.description: Command register. Holds the one-shot commands of the IP.

fields.name: init
fields.description:
Initialization command. Starts a new message in the selected context: loads the initial hash value or clears the Keccak state, and clears the length counter and the FIFOs of that context.

Usage: Software writes 1 to start the action; hardware clears the bit when the action has been accepted or completed. Do not write the register again while a bit is set.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 start the action.

Unit: none

Limits: Rejected with the configuration error event when the algorithm is not built or the context is busy.

fields.name: final
fields.description:
Final command. Tells the IP that the last word of the message has been written; it adds the padding and finishes the message of the selected context.

Usage: Software writes 1 to start the action; hardware clears the bit when the action has been accepted or completed. Do not write the register again while a bit is set.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 start the action.

Unit: none

Limits: Write the length register first; rejected with the configuration error event when the context is not in the absorbing state.

fields.name: abort
fields.description:
Abort command. Drops the message of the selected context, clears its FIFOs and state and returns it to the free state.

Usage: Software writes 1 to start the action; hardware clears the bit when the action has been accepted or completed. Do not write the register again while a bit is set.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 start the action.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: srst
fields.description:
Soft reset command. Clears all contexts, FIFOs, cores and the error record and keeps the control, security and DMA registers.

Usage: Software writes 1 to start the action; hardware clears the bit when the action has been accepted or completed. Do not write the register again while a bit is set.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 start the action.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: clear
fields.description:
Clear command. Writes zero into the context memory, the FIFOs and the core registers of the selected context without changing the algorithm field.

Usage: Software writes 1 to start the action; hardware clears the bit when the action has been accepted or completed. Do not write the register again while a bit is set.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 start the action.

Unit: none

Limits: Ignored when the capability register reports no state clearing.

fields.name: seed
fields.description:
Seed command. Loads the random generator of the masked Keccak core from the seed words that software wrote.

Usage: Software writes 1 to start the action; hardware clears the bit when the action has been accepted or completed. Do not write the register again while a bit is set.

Values:
0x0 no action (reset value);
0x1 start the action.

Unit: none

Limits: Accepted only when the seed source of the capability register is the seed registers.

registers.name: sha_len
registers.description: Length register. Gives the number of valid bytes of the last word of the message in the selected context.

fields.name: tail
fields.description:
Valid bytes of the last word. Number of bytes of the last word written to the input window that belong to the message; the other bytes are ignored.

Usage: Write it before the final command; software always writes full words, so the last word carries the message bytes in its low lanes.

Values:
0x00 all bytes of the last word are valid (reset value);
0x01 to 0x7F valid bytes, below the bytes of one word.

Unit: bytes

Limits: Must be below the bytes of one AXI word; a larger value sets the configuration error event.

registers.name: sha_dmac
registers.description: DMA control register. Holds the burst size and the burst timeout of the external DMA handshake.

fields.name: burst
fields.description:
Burst size. Number of AXI words in one burst of the external DMA handshake; a request is raised when the input FIFO can take or the output FIFO can give this many words.

Usage: Program it while no message runs to match the burst length configured in the DMA controller.

Values:
0x001 to 0x100 words per burst (reset value 0x010).

Unit: AXI words

Limits: Zero and values above 0x100 are illegal; the request is then not raised and the configuration error event is set.

fields.name: tmo
fields.description:
Burst timeout. Number of clock cycles without new digest words after which a short output burst is padded with zeros and requested.

Usage: Program it when the digest is shorter than one burst; the number of valid words is reported in the valid words register.

Values:
0x0000 timeout disabled (reset value);
0x0001 to 0xFFFF timeout in clock cycles.

Unit: clock cycles

Limits: none

registers.name: sha_sec
registers.description: Security register. Enables state clearing, the fault detection mechanisms and the responses to a detected fault.

fields.name: zero
fields.description:
Automatic clearing enable. Clears the state of a context after its digest has been read or the message has been aborted, and holds the core registers at zero while idle.

Usage: Enable it to limit the retention of message-dependent data in idle registers. It is not a side-channel countermeasure.

Values:
0x0 off;
0x1 on (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: Ignored when state clearing is not built.

fields.name: fault
fields.description:
Fault detection enable. Turns on the detection mechanisms selected by the duplicate, parity and recompute fields.

Usage: Set it while no message runs, after choosing the mechanisms.

Values:
0x0 off (reset value);
0x1 on.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: fdup
fields.description:
Duplicate-core detection select. Compares the output of each core with the output of its duplicate.

Usage: Set it only when the capability register reports duplicate detection as built.

Values:
0x0 not selected (reset value);
0x1 selected.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: fpar
fields.description:
Parity detection select. Checks the parity bits of the core state registers and the context memory.

Usage: Set it only when the capability register reports parity detection as built.

Values:
0x0 not selected (reset value);
0x1 selected.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: fredo
fields.description:
Recompute detection select. Computes every block twice and compares the two results; the throughput halves.

Usage: Set it only when the capability register reports recompute detection as built.

Values:
0x0 not selected (reset value);
0x1 selected.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: resp
fields.description:
Fault response select. Bit 0 gates the digest and output words until soft reset; bit 1 locks the IP until soft reset; bit 2 clears all context state; bit 3 raises the alarm output.

Usage: Program it while no message runs; the fault event and interrupt are always raised.

Values:
0x0 to 0xF mask of the active responses (reset value 0x3).

Unit: mask

Limits: Bit 3 has an effect only when the alarm output is built.

registers.name: sha_seed
registers.description: Seed register. Write-only words of the seed of the random generator of the masked Keccak core.

fields.name: wd
fields.description:
Seed word. One 32-bit word of the seed; reads return zero and the hardware clears the word after the seed command has copied it.

Usage: Write the eight words before the seed command; used only when the seed source of the capability register is the seed registers.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF seed word (reset value 0x00000000).

Unit: none

Limits: Eight words are used.

registers.name: sha_sts
registers.description: Status register. Reports the state of the IP and of the selected context.

fields.name: busy
fields.description:
IP busy. A block is being computed or a message waits for the core.

Usage: Poll it to know when the IP is idle before the soft reset command.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: idle
fields.description:
IP idle. No block is in a core and no word waits in an input FIFO.

Usage: Use it as the condition for changing the security and the control registers.

Values:
0x0 not idle;
0x1 idle (reset value).

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: ready
fields.description:
Digest ready. The digest of the selected context has been computed and its first words are in the output FIFO.

Usage: Poll it after the final command, or use the done event.

Values:
0x0 not ready (reset value);
0x1 ready.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: locked
fields.description:
IP locked. A fault response locked the IP until the soft reset command.

Usage: Give the soft reset command to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not locked (reset value);
0x1 locked.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: dmaact
fields.description:
DMA active. The external DMA handshake has a request raised or an acknowledge pending.

Usage: Read for diagnosis.

Values:
0x0 no DMA activity (reset value);
0x1 DMA activity.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: seeded
fields.description:
Random generator seeded. The random generator of the masked Keccak core has a valid seed.

Usage: Wait for 1 before the first masked SHA-3 or SHAKE message.

Values:
0x0 not seeded (reset value);
0x1 seeded.

Unit: none

Limits: Meaningful only when masked Keccak is built.

fields.name: cstate

registers.name: sha_lvl
registers.description: FIFO level register. Reports the fill level of the FIFOs of the selected context.

fields.name: inlvl
fields.description:
Input FIFO level. Number of AXI words in the input FIFO of the selected context.

Usage: Read before writing words into the window to avoid dropped words.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF words in the FIFO (reset value 0x0000).

Unit: AXI words

Limits: Bounded by the input FIFO depth parameter.

fields.name: outlvl
fields.description:
Output FIFO level. Number of AXI words in the output FIFO of the selected context.

Usage: Read before reading the window to avoid reading zeros.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF words in the FIFO (reset value 0x0000).

Unit: AXI words

Limits: Bounded by the output FIFO depth parameter.

registers.name: sha_blk
registers.description: Block counter register. Counts the blocks that the cores have processed for the selected context.

fields.name: cnt
fields.description:
Processed blocks. Number of compression or permutation blocks computed for the message in the selected context since its init command.

Usage: Read after an error or an abort to find where the message stopped.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF block count (reset value 0x00000000).

Unit: blocks

Limits: Cleared by the init, abort and soft reset commands; wraps at the maximum value.

registers.name: sha_byte
registers.description: Byte counter register. Counts the message bytes absorbed for the selected context.

fields.name: cnt
fields.description:
Absorbed bytes. Low 32 bits of the number of message bytes written for the message in the selected context since its init command.

Usage: Read to check the length of a stream against the expected length before the final command.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF byte count (reset value 0x00000000).

Unit: bytes

Limits: Cleared by the init, abort and soft reset commands; wraps at the maximum value.

registers.name: sha_dvld
registers.description: Valid words register. Reports the valid words of the last padded external DMA output burst.

fields.name: words
fields.description:
Valid words of the last burst. Number of real digest or output words in the last output burst that was padded with zeros after a timeout.

Usage: Read it after the DMA timeout event to discard the padding words.

Values:
0x000 to 0x100 valid words (reset value 0x000).

Unit: AXI words

Limits: Zero means that no burst was padded.

registers.name: sha_err
registers.description: Error information register. Records the latest window error of the IP.

fields.name: ctx
fields.description:
Error context. Context number of the latest window error.

Usage: Read after an overflow or underflow event.

Values:
0x00 to 0x0F context number (reset value 0x00).

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: kind
ovf
fields.description:
Overflow count. Number of dropped writes since the last soft reset; saturates at 255.

Usage: Read to judge how much data was lost.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF dropped writes (reset value 0x00).

Unit: events

Limits: Saturating.

fields.name: udf
fields.description:
Underflow count. Number of reads of an empty window since the last soft reset; saturates at 255.

Usage: Read to judge how many zero words software received.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF empty reads (reset value 0x00).

Unit: events

Limits: Saturating.

registers.name: sha_erra
registers.description: Error address register. Records the low 32 bits of the AXI address of the latest window error.

fields.name: addr
fields.description:
Error address. Low 32 bits of the AXI address that caused the latest window error.

Usage: Read together with the error information register.

Values:
0x00000000 to 0xFFFFFFFF AXI address (reset value 0x00000000).

Unit: bytes

Limits: none

registers.name: sha_irq_raw
registers.description: Raw interrupt register. Holds the sticky events of the IP.

fields.name: cdone
fields.description:
Context done event. The message of the context whose bit number is set has finished: its digest is ready, or for a SHAKE message its first output block is ready.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0000 no event (reset value);
0x0001 to 0xFFFF bit mask of the contexts that finished.

Unit: none

Limits: Bits above the context count are always 0.

fields.name: ovf
fields.description:
FIFO overflow event. A write to a full input FIFO window was dropped.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: udf
fields.description:
FIFO underflow event. A read of an empty output FIFO window returned zero.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: axi
fields.description:
AXI error event. The AXI4 subordinate rejected an unsupported transaction with SLVERR.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: cfg
fields.description:
Configuration error event. A command or a register value was rejected: algorithm not built, context busy or out of range, or an illegal length or burst.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: flt
fields.description:
Fault detected event. A fault detection mechanism found a mismatch and the responses of the security register were applied.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: ent
fields.description:
Entropy starved event. The masked Keccak core needed random bits and the random generator had no valid seed or entropy.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: tmo
fields.description:
DMA timeout event. The burst timer expired and a short output burst was padded with zeros.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: len
fields.description:
Length limit event. A message exceeded the maximum length of 2 to the power 61 minus 1 bytes.

Usage: Hardware sets the bit when the event happens; software writes 1 to clear it. A hardware set in the same cycle as a clear wins.

Values:
0x0 no event (reset value);
0x1 event pending.

Unit: none

Limits: none

registers.name: sha_irq_en
registers.description: Interrupt enable register. Enables each event to raise the interrupt outputs.

fields.name: cdone
fields.description:
Context done enable. Lets the context done event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0000 all masked (reset value);
0x0001 to 0xFFFF bit mask of the contexts whose done event is enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: Bits above the context count are always 0.

fields.name: ovf
fields.description:
FIFO overflow enable. Lets the FIFO overflow event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: udf
fields.description:
FIFO underflow enable. Lets the FIFO underflow event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: axi
fields.description:
AXI error enable. Lets the AXI error event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: cfg
fields.description:
Configuration error enable. Lets the configuration error event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: flt
fields.description:
Fault detected enable. Lets the fault detected event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: ent
fields.description:
Entropy starved enable. Lets the entropy starved event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: tmo
fields.description:
DMA timeout enable. Lets the DMA timeout event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: len
fields.description:
Length limit enable. Lets the length limit event raise the interrupt output.

Usage: Set it after the event handler is ready; the raw event is recorded whatever its value.

Values:
0x0 event masked (reset value);
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none

Limits: none

registers.name: sha_irq_inj
registers.description: Interrupt injection register. Injects events for software tests.

fields.name: cdone
fields.description:
Context done injection. A rising edge of this bit sets the raw context done event once.

Usage: Write 1 then write 0 before the next injection; used to test the handler.

Values:
0x0000 no injection (reset value);
0x0001 to 0xFFFF bit mask of the contexts to inject.

Unit: none

Limits: Bits above the context count are always 0.

fields.name: ovf
fields.description:
FIFO overflow injection. A rising edge of this bit sets the raw FIFO overflow event once.

Usage: Write 1 then write 0 before the next injection; used to test the handler.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject the event.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: udf
fields.description:
FIFO underflow injection. A rising edge of this bit sets the raw FIFO underflow event once.

Usage: Write 1 then write 0 before the next injection; used to test the handler.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject the event.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: axi
fields.description:
AXI error injection. A rising edge of this bit sets the raw AXI error event once.

Usage: Write 1 then write 0 before the next injection; used to test the handler.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject the event.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: cfg
fields.description:
Configuration error injection. A rising edge of this bit sets the raw configuration error event once.

Usage: Write 1 then write 0 before the next injection; used to test the handler.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject the event.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: flt
fields.description:
Fault detected injection. A rising edge of this bit sets the raw fault detected event once.

Usage: Write 1 then write 0 before the next injection; used to test the handler.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject the event.

Unit: none

Limits: none

fields.name: ent
fields.description:
Entropy starved injection. A rising edge of this bit sets the raw entropy starved event once.

Usage: Write 1 then write 0 before the next injection; used to test the handler.

Values:
0x0 no injection (reset value);
0x1 inject the event.

Unit: none

Limits: none

registers.name: sha_irq_sts
registers.description: Masked interrupt status register. Shows the enabled events that are pending.

fields.name: cdone
fields.description:
Context done status. The context done event is pending and enabled.

Usage: Read it in the interrupt handler to find the cause; it is the raw event AND the enable.

Values:
0x0000 none pending (reset value);
0x0001 to 0xFFFF bit mask of the contexts pending.

Unit: none

Limits: Bits above the context count are always 0.
